analyzed_vuln.description: In DeltaByteArrayDecoder::GetInternal, decoded suffix ByteArray pointers (buffer[i].ptr from suffix_decoder_) can alias the destination reconstruction buffer (buffered_data_) after Resize/reallocation, but the code unconditionally uses memcpy to append suffix bytes: memcpy(data_ptr + prefix_len_ptr[i], buffer[i].ptr, buffer[i].len). For this PoV, source and destination ranges overlap, triggering ASan memcpy-param-overlap. Root cause is missing overlap-safe copy (memmove) / alias handling when rebuilding DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY values.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A crafted Parquet DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY page drives DeltaLengthByteArrayDecoder + DeltaByteArrayDecoder so that suffix data pointers reference memory overlapping the newly resized buffered_data_ region during GetInternal reconstruction. Via parquet-arrow-fuzz -> reader.cc -> column_reader.cc -> DeltaByteArrayDecoder::DecodeArrowDense -> GetInternal, attacker-controlled prefix/suffix lengths and payload layout cause overlapping src/dst in the second memcpy, producing the crash.
